worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.summary: Break the shell and scatter its fragments, raising Attack, Special Attack and Speed while lowering Defence and Special Defence. Total smash increases both the boosts and defensive cost, with longer windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.use.0: Trade defense for a burst before a fight
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.use.1: Break the shell while the foe is out of reach
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.use.2: When surrounded, blow the shell apart and gamble on a quick fight
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.description: The smash raises Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed by %1$s and lowers Defense and Sp. Def by %2$s; the changes persist until the encounter fades and never wear off on their own.
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.total.on: Total smash: Attack, Special Attack and Speed +%1$s; Defence and Special Defence −%2$s, with longer windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.total.off: Steady smash: Attack/Sp. Atk/Speed +2, Defense/Sp. Def -1, quicker to start with a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.shellsmash.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
